description:
3Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1) This is my second question I’m an SDA, someone got up in church and made a statement that we are not sinners but children of God. I began to think about it. As I look through the Bible and the spirit of prophecy I sinners referred to as outside of Christ and those who are unrepentant, I see those who are rebellious and do not look at the cross to accept Christ's righteousness. I don’t want to dwell on the topic if it’s biblically incorrect what I’m thinking. Or even shouldn’t dwell on it. Is there a simple yes or no answer to the question?
.
2) Question to the Pastor is there a reference in the bible or SOP on the High Priest having ropes to pull him out of the most Holy Place when he dies inside or its just a proposal by commentators."
.
3) I'd like to know which books do you recommend for learning Church's history since its beginnings in the 1st century besides "The Great Controversy". Which do you think is the best or which do you prefer and why?
.
.
